absent: User control page full field layout beyond auxiliary offset and size.
Open and close lifetime reference counting and accounting release details.
Security readability check policy and failure semantics.
Driver auxiliary setup and free callback contracts and private lifetime.
Event context detach and revoked transition coordination.
Watermark wakeup signaling and overwrite consumer visibility rules.
Deferred free work scheduling and execution context.
Recursion guard table sizing and nesting limits.
Fork exec and exit interactions beyond uncopyable marking and tombstone checks.
Timing and user page refresh contents and ordering guarantees.

findings.text: Provides allocation of a sampling buffer with one control page plus caller requested data pages, taking page count with watermark with target processor with mode flags, returning null on failure. Two build variants exist, one keeping discrete pages and one using a contiguous virtual allocation with order encoding.

Provides allocation and driver setup of the auxiliary area for a sampling buffer, taking start offset with page count with watermark with mode flags, validating device support and size bounds and establishing reference counting and driver private state, cleaning up partially on failure.

Initializes a freshly allocated sampling buffer, establishing watermark defaults with overwrite behavior with reference and map counts with event list with event lock with paused state for empty buffers with auxiliary mutex and owning user.
Expose helpers to acquire and release the current task software event recursion guard, delegating to per task recursion bookkeeping for nesting protection.

Offset zero within a sampling mapping denotes the user control page known as user_page and permits write fault handling without error, while any higher page offset presented to the write fault path signals a bus error, enforcing read only data and auxiliary contents with a single writable control page.

Sampling mappings forbid virtual area splitting through handler may_split always rejecting attempts as invalid, and are documented as non mergeable with lifetime managed by handlers open and close with reference counting rather than by split derived regions.

Data capacity excluding the control page is either zero or a power of two, enabling mask based indexing. Remapping an existing buffer requires identical effective data capacity derived from base count known as nr_pages shifted by order known as page_order, requires the event already hold a map reference known as mmap_count to avoid aliasing the control page, and either bumps the shared map count or detaches after losing a close race.

Auxiliary remapping is accepted only when the buffer exists, when advertised offset and size match the requested start and length, when the region lies above control plus data, when length is a nonzero power of two, and when any prior auxiliary mapping agrees on start known as aux_pgoff and count known as aux_nr_pages. A live shared count must be acquirable.

AUX allocation requires device auxiliary support and a positive count, rejects oversized pointer tables, defaults and bounds watermarks differently for overwrite versus non overwrite modes, prefers larger chunks when device capabilities indicate no scatter gather or prefer large extents, and in overwrite no scatter mode demands a single contiguous chunk.

Zero watermark requests known as watermark or aux_watermark resolve to half of available capacity, clamped where required. Writable mode selects non overwrite behavior with watermark enabled, while other mappings select overwrite behavior known as overwrite or aux_overwrite with watermark cleared. Empty data buffers start paused because output gating checks only paused state.

Map charging first consumes a per user lock allowance derived from a sysctl scaled by online processor count, spilling excess from user portion into extra held in per address space pinned accounting, then checks pinned total against the memlock limit with bypass for non paranoid settings or lock capability. Accounting adds the split portions to user locked and address space pinned counters.

Offset translation for index known as pgoff resolves higher auxiliary ranges beyond start known as aux_pgoff within count known as aux_nr_pages through table known as aux_pages with bounded speculation hardened indexing, control offset through page known as user_page, and data offsets through either discrete array known as data_pages or contiguous virtual base plus scaled offset, returning null when beyond the respective capacity including the control page in the bound.

Mapping entry rejects inherited per task events, requires shared semantics, enforces page aligned non empty sizes bounded by a signed maximum, performs a security readability check, and fails revoked or earlier states as missing device.

Data and control page allocation obtains zeroed order zero pages from the node associated with the target processor, or any node when processor is unspecified, returning a kernel virtual address. Freeing converts back to the page frame and releases it.

The auxiliary mutex known as aux_mutex is held while installing page table entries for a sampling area and while validating or creating auxiliary mappings, serializing concurrent mappers against auxiliary allocation, offset publication and teardown.

A per event mapping mutex known as mmap_mutex serializes buffer creation, reuse and revoked state observation against concurrent detach, ensuring either the revoked state is seen or detach later removes the freshly created buffer, and stabilizes map count during first map failure cleanup.

Asynchronous notification setup known as fasync serializes under the file inode lock. Descriptor info reporting holds the event context lock together with the relevant child mutex known as child_mutex from parent or self to stabilize hierarchy while emitting attributes. Buffer initialization creates event spinlock known as event_lock with list known as event_list plus auxiliary mutex and list head.

The sampling virtual operations table known as perf_mmap_vmops wires open and close lifetime handlers with write fault handler known as pfn_mkwrite that gates writability by offset and split handler known as may_split that always refuses, expressing non mergeable PFN map semantics.

The sampling file operations table known as perf_fops wires handlers release with read with poll with native control known as unlocked_ioctl with compatibility control known as compat_ioctl with mmap with async known as fasync and descriptor info known as show_fdinfo.

Observed sampling buffer state comprises control pointer known as user_page with data array known as data_pages with base count known as nr_pages and order known as page_order, auxiliary table known as aux_pages with count known as aux_nr_pages and start known as aux_pgoff, watermarks known as watermark and aux_watermark, overwrite flags known as overwrite and aux_overwrite, paused flag known as paused, reference counts known as refcount with mmap_count with aux_mmap_count and aux_refcount, owning user known as mmap_user with locked extents known as mmap_locked and aux_mmap_locked, event list known as event_list with lock known as event_lock, auxiliary mutex known as aux_mutex, driver private known as aux_priv with free callback known as free_aux, and deferred work known as work in one variant.

Mapping proceeds from validation to creation or reuse of data versus auxiliary storage based on start offset, marks the area uncopyable with unexpandable and undumpable, installs sampling operations, notifies device mapped hooks, then installs page table entries. First map failure undoes notification accounting and attachment and clears the count, while later map failure delegates to close handling.

Data mapping first discounts the control page and checks power of two sizing, then either reuses a live buffer with matching capacity and non zero event map count known as mmap_count or allocates a new buffer after limit checks, selecting writable mode from area flags with wakeup threshold from watermark, attaching, refreshing timing and user page, accounting and setting the map count to one.

Auxiliary storage is filled greedily from largest feasible orders known as max_order downward, allocating with fallback to smaller orders, splitting higher order pages and tagging the head with its order for driver visibility, then requiring single chunk continuity for non scatter overwrite devices before invoking driver setup to obtain private known as aux_priv and publishing offset known as aux_pgoff with reference state known as aux_refcount, freeing partially on any failure.

Deferred disable reads the resident processor known as oncpu. Idle events need no action, events local to the caller clear pending flag known as pending_disable and disable locally, and remote running events are re queued to the owning processor through work known as pending_disable_irq. The work entry wraps this with software recursion guarding that tolerates already disabled nesting.

Signal trap delivery is suppressed after task exit bookkeeping marked tombstone and warns and suppresses on processor context mismatch, otherwise delivering a perf signal with the pending address, original type and configured signal payload.

The file mmap entry known as perf_mmap acts as dispatcher, routing zero start offset requests to data path known as perf_mmap_rb and nonzero start offsets to auxiliary path known as perf_mmap_aux, after shared, size and state checks under the mapping mutex.

Virtual memory entry points comprise page write fault hook known as pfn_mkwrite gating writability to offset zero and split veto hook known as may_split, installed as part of sampling area operations alongside open and close.

Remaining entries comprise async enablement known as perf_fasync guarded by revoked state and inode serialization, descriptor info emission known as perf_show_fdinfo of type and configuration attributes under context and hierarchy locks, and interrupt work handler known as perf_pending_disable that forwards deferred disable with recursion protection.

Page table installation maps each page read only for later fault gating and on any missing page or mapping error removes any partial installation when address translation is present. Concurrent reuse versus close races are resolved by reference acquisition failure followed by detach and fresh allocation rather than reuse.

Auxiliary page allocation clamps excessive orders beyond the maximum and retries downward until success or exhaustion, avoiding fragmentation and oversized requests. Trap and disable paths must tolerate exit, exec and migration races by checking tombstone marking and current task identity before acting.

Copying sampling areas across fork is prohibited via uncopyable marking because pinned accounting is per address space, and revoked events must be rejected even under lock to coordinate with detach that may concurrently remove the buffer.

ABI facts: control page at offset zero, data capacity without control zero or power of two, auxiliary length power of two pages, mappings page granular with total bounded by INT_MAX, auxiliary region above control plus data at advertised offset known as aux_offset with size known as aux_size, illegal data write faults report VM_FAULT_SIGBUS.

ABI facts: shared mapping flagged by VM_SHARED required with writability flagged by VM_WRITE selecting non overwrite mode flagged by RING_BUFFER_WRITABLE, areas gain marks VM_DONTCOPY with VM_DONTEXPAND and VM_DONTDUMP, revoked state flagged by PERF_EVENT_STATE_REVOKED fails as missing device, exit tombstone flagged by TASK_TOMBSTONE suppresses signals, lock allowance base known as sysctl_perf_event_mlock with limit RLIMIT_MEMLOCK and capability CAP_IPC_LOCK and order ceiling MAX_PAGE_ORDER steer checks, device hints PERF_PMU_CAP_AUX_NO_SG with PERF_PMU_CAP_AUX_PREFER_LARGE steer chunking, failures use EINVAL with EBUSY with EPERM with ENOMEM with ENODEV with EOPNOTSUPP as appropriate.

ABI facts: event attributes carry type with config plus config1 plus config2 plus config3 plus config4 plus inherit plus watermark with wakeup_watermark and aux_watermark, descriptor info exposes perf_event_attr type with pmu_type and config values, signal delivery uses pending_addr with orig_type and sig_data, auxiliary advertisement uses aux_offset with aux_size.
